title: Community
description: A Lemmy community (subreddit-equivalent) where posts and discussions are organized.

name.description: Short identifier name of the community (slug)

removed.description: Whether the community was removed by a site admin

published.description: Timestamp when the community was created

updated.description: Timestamp when the community was last updated

nsfw.description: Whether the community is marked as NSFW

local.description: Whether the community is hosted on this instance

icon.description: URL of the community icon image

banner.description: URL of the community banner image

hidden.description: Whether the community is hidden from listings

posting_restricted_to_mods.description: Whether only moderators can create posts

instance_id.description: ID of the instance hosting this community
